items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (Multiple vulnerabilities)
items.summary: This security update addresses multiple vulnerabilities, including critical, high, and medium severity issues that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system write, and security feature bypass. Adobe recommends applying the hotfix for CVE-2026-75650 in addition to this update.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source (Multiple vulnerabilities)
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could result in security feature bypass and privilege escalation. Adobe also advises applying the hotfix for CVE-2026-75650.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE)
items.summary: Sansec discovered StyleSmuggler, a zero-day vulnerability in Magento and Adobe Commerce that allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution by injecting malicious code into Magento's template system. Adobe released an emergency hotfix for this critical vulnerability, which has been actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (Multiple vulnerabilities, including unauthenticated RCE and privilege escalation)
items.summary: This update addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, with CVE-2026-71362 being a critical incorrect authorization flaw allowing unauthenticated privilege escalation. Other vulnerabilities include stored XSS leading to arbitrary code execution and security feature bypasses.

items.title: Adobe Commerce RCE Vulnerability (Improper Encoding)
items.summary: This is an Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce, Adobe Commerce B2B, Magento Open Source, and the Adobe I/O Events extension for Commerce, leading to arbitrary code execution without user interaction or authentication.

items.title: Amasty patches dozens of Magento extensions, 6 critical
items.summary: Amasty released a massive security update for dozens of its Magento extensions, addressing six critical vulnerabilities that could lead to remote code execution, account takeover, admin login bypass, and payment fraud.
